title: ReviewItem
description: Schema for Tripplankaro traveler reviews uploaded by Admin (matching Google Form submission)

title.description: Headline or short title of the review e.g. 'Overall Tripplankaro Did an Excellent Job'

name.description: Traveler or couple name from Google Form (e.g. 'Mr. Sagar Savsani' or 'Kavita & Amit Saxena')

trip_type.description: Type of trip e.g. 'Individual Tour', 'Group Tour', 'Honeymoon Tour', 'Family Vacation'

review.description: Overall Experience & Highlights from the Google Form

photos.description: 2-3 Photos or video URLs uploaded by user in Google Form. The first photo is displayed on the card.

image.description: Primary photo URL (auto-synced with photos[0] if omitted)

whatsapp_number.description: Traveler WhatsApp number (stored securely in admin record, not displayed publicly)

email.description: Traveler Email address (stored securely in admin record, not displayed publicly)
